$description: Lone Star design tokens, read out of the code on 2026-09-17 (src/app/globals.css, src/app/layout.tsx, src/components/ui/ui.tsx). Import into Figma with a free variables-import plugin, or type them in by hand — there are only a few. Keep this file and the CSS in step: the CSS is the source of truth, this is its mirror.

color.$description: The manager surface: black and white, with blue and red used sparingly.

ink.$description: Text, and anything solid and black.

surface.$description: Cards and panels on the page.

accent.$description: The only blue. Links, primary action, pending state.

cinematic.$description: The dark palette the artist-site template ships with (.theme-cinematic). A separate collection in Figma: artist sites, not Lone Star's own.

body.$description: Names, titles, body. Weights 400-700, all from one variable font.

mono.$description: Labels, numbers, stats. Weights 400 and 700 ONLY — Space Mono has no others.

display.$description: The artist-site template's display face. Weights 700, 800, 900.

type.$description: The sizes actually used on the manager surface, in px. Labels are mono, uppercase, letter-spaced; body is Instrument Sans at its natural spacing.

label.$description: Space Mono 700, uppercase, tracking 0.12em. The KLabel above every block.

stat.$description: Space Mono 700, tracking -0.02em. The big numbers.

space.$description: A 4px grid. Set Figma's nudge to 4 and these become the only gaps you need.
